description.value: A private highway-side campground on Highway 95 near Parson, set within the Columbia Wetlands and surrounded by mountains, offering tent sites with access to a shower house, flush toilets, coin laundry, and WiFi; open May through September with a nightly gate closure at 10 pm.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Quinn Creek Campground is a seasonal campground near Parson on Highway 95 with both full-service (power/water/sewer) and non-service tent sites. The contact page provides phone (250 348 2252), email, and address (4430 Highway 95, Parson) not present in OSM. Amenities explicitly mentioned on the website include shower house with flush toilets, coin laundry and dryer, wash-station for non-service guests, WIFI, and online reservations. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, or cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; website provides 4430 Highway 95, Parson and 250 348 2252 — these should be added to OSM
Gate closure 10pm–7am means no vehicle access during those hours; cyclists arriving late should be aware
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate seasonal campground on Highway 95 with non-service tent sites, showers, laundry, and WIFI — a practical stop for touring cyclists riding through the Columbia Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email listed on website: camp@quinncreek.bc.ca. Open May through September only.

wow_evidence: shower house with flush toilets, coin laundry and dryer, wash-station for non-service guests, WIFI
